storage: append-only JSONL week-files under <archive>/cftctff/, one file per REPORT date (gz after 9 days — a report stays plain until superseded)
written_by: server/cftcTff.ts archiveTffWeek (12h poll of the weekly source, eager boot)
source: CFTC Public Reporting Socrata API, dataset gpe5-46if (Traders in Financial Futures, futures-only) — keyless JSON with NAMED fields, the financial-futures sibling of the cftccot stream. ~44 markets/week (ES/NQ/rates/FX-class); Tuesday as-of data published Friday ~15:30 ET; dataset history to 2006. Field names verified live 2026-07-06 incl. quirks (dealer_* keeps the _all suffix, asset_mgr_*/lev_money_* drop it)
license: US government work, public domain; attribution 'CFTC Traders in Financial Futures'

field_map.report_date — week-level dedup key: one coherent week per file; a DESC fetch straddling two weeks keeps ONLY the newest (vintages never mix)
field_map.market/code/commodity: market+exchange name, CFTC contract market code, commodity name as published
field_map.dealer_/asset_mgr_/lev_money_/other_rept: the TFF trader categories' positions; missing/empty values are null, never zero

confidence_model: RAW official weekly positioning data. Futures-ONLY report (the combined variant is dataset yw9f-hn96 — do not conflate). Positioning percentile/extreme SIGNALS require trailing history the archive is only beginning to accumulate — nothing is claimed until ladder gate 2.
cadence: weekly source (Friday ~15:30 ET publish); 12h poll makes off-days a dedup no-op
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). BUILD ORDER 6 #1; hypothesis (leveraged-money extremes mean-revert in index futures; dealer is the informed side; joins the COT commodities archive) stays gate-locked — archive + RAW display only.
